## Code Smell: god_class / large module

- **Files:** `example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngine.ts` (2452 lines), `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetAnimator.ts` (1942), `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetRenderer.ts` (1902), `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetTurnController.ts` (1834), `MainStreetState.ts` (1599), `MainStreetCards.ts` (1469), `MainStreetAdjacency.ts` (1354), `MainStreetMarket.ts` (1307), `scenes/MainStreetLifecycleManager.ts` (1111)
- **Lines:** see wc -l above (all >1000, 4 >1800)
- **Severity:** medium
- **Smell type:** god_class / large file
- **Source:** structural heuristic (wc -l per game, threshold 800)
- **Detection:** CG-0MTHTJZGM003JX8X

### Description
MainStreet has outgrown single-file modules — 8 files exceed 1000 lines and 4 exceed 1800, well above the 800-line threshold. Each mixes state, rendering, animation, and turn logic. Prior god-class CG-0MM1OP07Q16TUTHI covered MainStreetScene.ts 3042 etc. and is closed; these modules are NEW (different files) so not a duplicate per AC4. Not engine-move (game-local).

### Remediation sketch
Split Animator/Renderer/TurnController further (extract per-concern helpers), decompose Engine (state + rules + commands already partially split), extract LifecycleManager sub-concerns (checkpoint, CSV/SVG prewarm). Target <800 lines per module, <500 for scenes.

### Dedup
Prior CG-0MM1OP07Q16TUTHI listed MainStreetScene 3042 etc. — not these modules. grep REFACTOR 0 hits.

---
